sections.label: 1 - CAPTURE AND VALIDATE
sections.note: One form, one webhook. Every enquiry is de-duplicated, standardized and checked against GoHighLevel before anything is created.

sections.label: 2 - AI QUALIFICATION, NEVER INVENTED
sections.note: Claude extracts the service, summarizes the enquiry and classifies it. Anything it cannot read is flagged, not guessed.

sections.label: 3 - INTO GOHIGHLEVEL
sections.note: Contact, custom fields, tags, opportunity stage and notes. Sales opens one record and sees the whole enquiry.

sections.label: 4 - FOLLOW UP UNTIL THEY REPLY, BOOK OR OPT OUT
sections.note: Approved messaging and the booking link go out on a sequence that stops itself the moment the lead responds.

sections.label: 5 - LOGS, RETRIES AND ALERTS
sections.note: Every run writes a log row. A failed step retries once on a delay, then it tells you instead of failing quietly.
